items.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
items.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

items.title: Mushroom murderer trial undermined by 'catastrophic' hotel mix-up, appeal court told
items.description: Erin Patterson's defence team appeal against her conviction for killing relatives with a beef Wellington laced with toxic mushrooms.

items.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close
items.description: The US president says the two sides are finalising documents to avert import taxes targeting a range of Canadian goods.

items.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
items.description: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

items.title: French civil servant drugged us to make us urinate on ourselves, say accusers
items.description: More than 200 women accuse Christian Nègre of drugging them to make them urinate - two share their stories.

items.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
items.description: Meta argued social media addiction does not exist, as a trial stemming from a major lawsuit brought by US states started.

items.title: Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low
items.description: The skeletal remains in Lake Mead include what appears to be a human jaw with teeth attached, a witness says.

items.title: US condemns 'unnecessary escalation' after Israeli airstrikes on Syrian airbase
items.description: Damascus called the attacks "an unjustified act of aggression" that imperilled regional security.

items.title: 'I don't want to send you to prison', witness tells Tupac accused in combative testimony
items.description: A member of Tupac Shakur's entourage said he was threatened with contempt of court if he did not testify in the murder trial of Duane "Keffe D" Davis.

items.title: US charges 17 Iranians over 'massive' cyber theft campaign
items.description: Many of the alleged cyber attacks were carried out for the Iranian government, the Department of Justice says.

items.title: Thai teen found in suitcase died from suffocation, police reveal
items.description: New evidence sheds more light on the death of Tunchanok Donholma, who was allegedly murdered in June.

items.title: Husband and mother-in-law charged over Indian bride's death
items.description: Twisha Sharma, a model and actor, had been married for just five months when she was found dead in May.

items.title: Alleged sexual assault by local official and businessman sparks outrage in China
items.description: Both men are arrested after the alleged assault on a woman at a karaoke bar during a business event.

items.title: Iranian academic writes of US detention 'hell' over link to 1979 hostage crisis
items.description: The immigration status of Maryam Tahmasebi was revoked because her husband is the son of a prominent figure in Iran.

items.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
items.description: Environmentalists have heavily criticised the exploratory drilling in the sea off the mouth of the Amazon.

items.title: Five Australian rules footy players suspended amid police investigation
items.description: The suspensions, for drinking and inviting women to a hotel, come as police investigate an alleged sexual assault.

items.title: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard dies aged 77
items.description: A statement on the blues-rock band's website said he died on Monday in hospice

items.title: Families' agonising search for answers as thousands still missing in Gaza
items.description: Ten months after a ceasefire was declared, thousands of Palestinians in Gaza are still reported missing.

items.title: The Indian activist jailed after taking on a luxury hotel plan
items.description: An activist's detention has brought under focus a larger battle over land and development around the famed Kaziranga National Park.

items.title: Why has Russia threatened the UK and what happens next?
items.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said London will continue "to support Ukraine 100%".
